description: Catalog ops of the browser host's listener (plans/cmux-next/browser-host.md, step b: the browser.repl.* REPL session ops). Request framing: one JSON line {id, method, params, origin}; reply {id, result} or {id, error: {code, message}}. Param names are the host's wire names. The browser host owns this file; cmux mcp and the generated CLI read it.

session.description: Session name: letters, digits, _, . or -. Default "default". Opening an existing session attaches to it.

engine.description: Browser engine. auto picks the default for this machine.

browser.repl.open.description: Open a browser REPL session, or attach to it when it exists.

session.description: Session name; opened on first use. Default "default".

code.description: JavaScript run in the session's sandboxed VM with the browser API (page, locators, keyboard, mouse, tabs, snapshot). Top-level variables persist between calls. browser_repl_guide describes the API.

timeoutMs.description: How long the code may run, in milliseconds.

maxOutput.description: Most characters of output to return; the rest is cut.

browser.repl.eval.description: Run JavaScript in a browser REPL session and return its printed output and error. Not replayed: an input whose result is lost is reported in_progress.

browser.repl.close.description: Close a browser REPL session and its tabs.

browser.repl.reset.description: Close a browser REPL session and open it again empty.

browser.repl.list.description: List the browser REPL sessions on this machine.

browser.repl.guide.description: Return the guide to the browser REPL API (what code passed to browser_repl_eval can call).
